text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity moving through this modern, open space. The glass walls and meeting spaces invite contemplation on transparency and collaboration. Upon seeing the vibrant "R+D" exhibit, my mind stirs with the idea of human ingenuity and our drive to understand and innovate. This environment stimulates my philosophical musings on the intersection of knowledge, creativity, and the social spaces we build for them. I feel both inspired and slightly out of place, aware of the contrast between the structured environment and the boundless nature of thought.
